Description: Citizens report road, streetlight and water damage with a geotagged photo, even while offline (FR-001, FR-002, NFR-001)
The system rejects or flags duplicate, photo-less and out-of-city reports before they reach staff (FR-003)
Valid reports reach the right department; officers assign engineers and update status with an audit trail (FR-004, NFR-002)
Citizens track Submitted > Under Review > Assigned > Resolved and get notified on each change (FR-005)
As a citizen, I want the app to read my GPS location and mark the damage on the map automatically, so that I don't have to type an address and the report reaches the right area's team.

Summary: Choose damage type and attach photo
Description: As a citizen, I want to choose the damage type (pothole / streetlight / water leak), upload a photo and add a short description, so that staff get the basic details of the complaint.
As a citizen in an area with poor network, I want my report saved offline and uploaded automatically when the network returns, so that I can report damage without losing data.
As a department officer, I want duplicate reports of the same damage flagged automatically, so that I don't waste time reviewing the same complaint twice.
As a department officer, I want reports with missing photos or locations outside the city rejected before they reach my queue, so that I only review valid complaints.
As a department officer, I want valid reports sent automatically to my department's queue, so that complaints reach the team that can fix them.
As a department officer, I want to review a report, assign a municipal engineer and change its status, so that work is tracked to completion.
As a municipal administrator, I want every status change logged with staff ID and time, and no report marked Resolved without a geotagged proof photo, so that staff stay accountable.
As a citizen, I want to see my report's status (Submitted > Under Review > Assigned > Resolved), so that I know progress is being made.
As a citizen, I want a notification whenever my report's status changes, so that I know when the damage is fixed without checking the app.
